Interpretation: Boris has 100 apples. Bick (or "بيك") has 23 apples less than Boris. So initially Bick has 100 - 23 = 77 apples. Then Boris gives Bick 10 apples. So after that, Boris loses 10 apples, Bick gains 10 apples.

After giving: Boris now has 100 - 10 = 90 apples. Bick now has 77 + 10 = 87 apples.

Now the question: "كم تفاحة أقل يمتلكها بيك من بوريس الآن؟" Means "How many apples fewer does Bick have than Boris now?" So difference = Boris - Bick = 90 - 87 = 3 apples.

Thus answer is 3.
